article.story: Old Dominion (3-7) at UConn (5-5), Nov. 21 at 3:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: UConn by 13.5. Against the spread: UConn 6-4, Old Dominion 2-8. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats UConn Offense Overall: 438.9 yards per game (26th in FBS) Passing: 249.4 yards per game (39th) Rushing: 189.5 yards per game (30th) Scoring: 34.2 points per game (24th) UConn Defense Overall: 386.4 yards per game (95th in FBS) Passing: 248.4 yards per game (123rd) Rushing: 138.0 yards per game (62nd) Scoring: 26.2 points per game (88th) Old Dominion Offense Overall: 267.6 yards per game (138th in FBS) Passing: 174.0 yards per game (121st) Rushing: 93.6 yards per game (134th) Scoring: 16.8 points per game (132nd) Old Dominion Defense Overall: 338.9 yards per game (43rd in FBS) Passing: 207.5 yards per game (62nd) Rushing: 131.4 yards per game (47th) Scoring: 25.8 points per game (81st) Old Dominion ranks 20th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 31.8% of third downs. Both teams are heavily penalized. UConn ranks 125th in the FBS averaging 72.2 penalty yards per game, and Old Dominion ranks 113th with a 65.0-yard average. UConn is 124th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 91.7% of trips. Old Dominion's red zone offense ranks 57th, scoring on 86.4% of red zone opportunities. Both teams rank low in time of possession. UConn is 119th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:54, while Old Dominion's 133rd-ranked average is 27:00. Team leaders UConn Passing: Kalieb Osborne, 2,376 yards, 19 TDs, 4 INTs, 60.0 completion percentage Rushing: Cyncir Bowers, 762 yards on 122 carries, 10 TDs Receiving: Shamar Porter, 468 yards on 22 catches, 4 TDs Old Dominion Passing: Quinn Henicle, 701 yards, 4 TDs, 4 INTs, 56.9 completion percentage Rushing: Devin Roche, 441 yards on 127 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Josh Rodriguez, 430 yards on 36 catches, 0 TDs Last game UConn beat James Madison 46-22 on Nov. 14. Osborne threw for 274 yards on 16-of-20 attempts (80.0%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 16 times for 88 yards. Bowers had 123 rushing yards on 25 carries and two touchdowns, adding one reception for two yards and one touchdown. Porter had four receptions for 135 yards and one touchdown. Old Dominion won 21-8 over Coastal Carolina on Nov. 7. Jaxon Potter passed for 150 yards on 17-of-30 attempts (56.7%) with one touchdown and one interception. Roche had 46 rushing yards on 18 carries, adding two receptions for 13 yards. Leon Haughton Jr. had six receptions for 67 yards and one touchdown. Next game UConn plays at Wyoming on Nov. 28. Old Dominion hosts Southern Miss on Nov. 28.
